authority: ADR 0025 decision 2 / DOCTRINE_ENFORCEMENT.md §3 — a census that reports is not a check. `check_production_genericity_flow.sh` already derives all eighteen counts on every commit; this is the declaration it compares them against, so a drift is caught at commit cadence instead of at push cadence by a cargo test.

boundary.rationale: These describe the genericity boundary itself — which types are sources, which roots are rules, which regions are trusted. Ordinary feature work does not move them: measured unchanged across the six consecutive slices that each moved the volume counts below. A change here is a real change to the product's authority structure and must fail closed. Moved once, deliberately, by EXTRACTION-QUALITY-GAUGE.3k.6: two non_authoritative_root rows (diagnostic.constraint_replay, diagnostic.constraint_replay_gates) register the read-only constraint replay, which reads raw evidence to report what the current producer still mints and writes nothing. Registering it as diagnostics_only rather than as a grammar root is the point — it has no authority over any artifact, and the boundary should say so. Moved a SECOND time, for the same reason and by the same shape, by SIGNAL-DECLARATION-ROW-DROP.4e: one non_authoritative_root row (diagnostic.declaration_replay) registers the read-only declaration replay, which reads raw evidence to report what the current SemanticIR declaration reader does with a persisted artifact's own statements and writes nothing. That the boundary had to be edited at all is the control working: a function that reads raw evidence and reaches semantic control cannot land silently, and declaring it diagnostics_only is the statement that it has authority over no artifact.

aggregate_change.rationale: INVARIANT-SHAPE-ADMISSION.6b adds nine functions, all one bounded sentence-shape grammar for the caption-admission repair: states_a_modal_obligation lifts the existing modal list so a sentence can be tested as well as a statement; caption_states_an_obligation composes R1+R2+R3 over a caption's sentences; has_sentence_terminator and sentences are R1's title proxy and its splitter; reports_its_referent is R2, anchored to the sentence OPENING so a reporting verb in a relative clause cannot refuse a real prohibition; states_a_prohibition and find_negated_permission are R3's two negated-permission forms; and is_word_character and starts_with_word are the whole-word helpers they share. Every rule reads STRUCTURE plus universal document grammar -- the nouns Figure and Table, a closed reporting-verb list, a sentence terminator -- and no document, vendor, protocol or signal identity, so it is not a new source, rule root or declassifier and every boundary count is unmoved. Its reach was adjudicated corpus-wide before it shipped (.6a, .6a.1) and measured after: 8 records removed, 15 added, 0 unexplained across 7 of 27 proof-carrying documents. Nine new analyzed functions, sixty-nine decision sites, thirty-three helper edges, and one semantic macro (the matches! that stops R3's negated-subject window at a clause break).

volume.rationale: These are sizes, not boundaries: they move whenever production code is added, which is every ordinary slice. Six consecutive slices moved them and each had to edit a literal to land. Declaring them as baseline + delta with an owner converts that edit from re-pinning a number nothing compares into attributing a census change to the leaf that caused it — the same `aggregate_change` idiom `doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl` already uses for the book's byte total.
